ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Rend.cs:24-27) == cost 2 / ATTACK / RARE / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `CalculationBaseVar(15m)` + `ExtraDamageVar(5m)` + `CalculatedDamageVar(ValueProp.Move).WithMultiplier((_, target) => target?.Powers.Count(ShouldCountPower) ?? 0)` (Rend.cs:17-22). `CalculatedVar.Calculate` is `base + extra * multiplier` (CalculatedVar.cs:62-71) == `self._base + self._extra * self._debuff_count(target)`, and the sim's null-target fallback of 0 matches C#'s `?? 0`. Move without Unpowered -> powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.CalculatedDamage).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (Rend.cs:32-34) == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, target, self.calc_damage(ctx, target), dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. The debuff count is read before the hit on both sides.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.ExtraDamage.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` + `DynamicVars.CalculationBase.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` (Rend.cs:39-40) == `_extra += 3` (5 -> 8) and `_base += 3` (15 -> 18). BOTH terms are upgraded, which makes Rend the only CalculatedDamage card in the pool whose upgrade touches the base as well as the extra -- card/ashen_strike, card/bully and card/perfected_strike all raise only the extra, so copying their shape would have lost the +3 base. Checked against this source, not the pattern.

guards.what: the ITemporaryPower exclusion is approximated by a single class (colorless_attacks.py:354-360)
guards.issue: C#'s `ShouldCountPower` is `power.TypeForCurrentAmount == PowerType.Debuff && !(power is ITemporaryPower)` (Rend.cs:43-50). The sim reproduces the SIGN-AWARE half well -- `power.power_type == PowerType.DEBUFF or (power.allow_negative and power.amount < 0)` covers a positive-typed power holding a negative amount, which is exactly what `TypeForCurrentAmount` is for (bug class 3 in audit/tools/PROMPT.md) -- but it excludes only `TemporaryStrengthPower`, where C# excludes every `ITemporaryPower`. There are FIVE implementers in the source: IllusionPower, SleightOfFleshPower, TemporaryDexterityPower, TemporaryFocusPower and TemporaryStrengthPower (grep over src/Core/Models/Powers). So a target carrying a negative TemporaryDexterity would be counted by the sim and excluded by the game, inflating Rend's damage by 5. DORMANT: of the five, only TemporaryStrengthPower's subclasses (ManglePower, DarkShacklesPower) are applied to ENEMIES by ported content, and those the sim already excludes; TemporaryDexterity/Focus and SleightOfFlesh have no ported enemy-facing applier, and Illusion is a buff. Live the moment any other ITemporaryPower is applied to an enemy. There is also a narrower residue: a DEBUFF-typed power holding a NEGATIVE amount is a Buff under `GetTypeForAmount` but still counted by the sim's first clause; no ported debuff can go negative (`allow_negative` is False for them), so that half is unreachable.
